verdict.rationale: uv is a pure CLI tool with a documented CLI reference. It has first-party GitHub Actions guidance via the official `astral-sh/setup-uv` action, which installs uv, adds it to PATH, persists the cache and supports Python-version matrices. It also offers non-interactive install via curl/pip and machine-readable output such as `uv version --output-format json`, so it clearly runs headlessly in CI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and documentation of non-interactive behavior and machine-readable output beyond a single JSON example.
